source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), Electric Power Annual, Table 11.1; EPRI Climate READi Appendix A; IEEE Std 1366-2012 section 4.3.1
subset_description: Twenty national aggregate rows for 2015-2024: IEEE all events and IEEE without Major Event Days. The EPRI-style event and its frequency are constructed. The IEEE momentary example retains published customer counts and frequencies with constructed timestamps and durations. See README.md for exact source locations and retrieval checksums.
citation: EIA, Electric Power Annual, Table 11.1, Reliability Metrics of U.S. Distribution System, Form EIA-861. EPRI, Planning for Climate Resilience in the Power System, Appendix A, Customer Outage Risk (CORi). IEEE Std 1366-2012, section 4.3.1, equations 47-49, printed page 17 (PDF page 28), Indiana docket 45647, Public's Exhibit CX-8.
license: EIA data are public domain (https://www.eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php). IEEE and EPRI retain copyright in their documents; only numerical facts and source citations are retained here, not their text, figures, or PDFs. The constructed scenarios and test encoding use BSD-3-Clause.
notes: EIA values are aggregate relationships, not an event-level arithmetic oracle. Half-last-digit bounds use 0.1 minute SAIDI/CAIDI and 0.001 SAIFI precision; trailing zeros omitted by the HTML do not reduce precision. The CAIDI tolerance propagates both ends of these rounding intervals and adds CAIDI rounding. Synthetic equivalent logs test accumulator consistency only. IEEE values reproduce one published worked example, not IEEE 1366-2022 conformance or grouping. There is no event-level oracle from an operational outage log for the sustained metrics or ASAI. No READi metric, fragility curve, event probability estimator, Major Event Day filter, or annualization is implemented by this fixture. The stated annual event frequency belongs to caller-side post-processing, not to reliability_indices().
